label: Early-middle copy-phase outputs (recalling original token 2-3) in short sequences
explanation: Copy-phase only (99.96% of mass; essentially silent in original and delimiter phases). Fires when the model is outputting original token 2-4, peaking at recall_idx 3 (36% rate, 67% of mass) and recall_idx 2 (19% of mass); almost never at recall_idx 0-1. Strongest in short sequences (L=4-6, especially L=5); rarer for L>=7 and never for L=3. Largest activations (top examples) are at recall_idx 2-3 of L=4-6 sequences. Within the window it is far from deterministic (precision ~0.4), with mild token-identity modulation (higher for outputs d/f/m/h and next output h; slightly lower for digit-heavy sequences), which the predicate does not capture. Does not fire on original-phase inputs, the delimiter, or the first two copy outputs.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: h, m, r, d, i, b; least: q, a, c, t) and the token being output (most: d, f, m, b, x, h; least: n, g, j, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=8, recall_idx=4.
